name: handoff_consistency
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys,hashlib
p=Path.cwd();r=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());ids=set(map(str,json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']));assert set(r)==ids and len(r)==20
raw=Path('original20.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True);assert len(raw)==20
prov=json.loads(Path('statement-provenance.json').read_text())
for b in raw:
 i=str(json.loads(b)['mathdb_id']);assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==prov[i]['raw_sha256'];assert b.endswith(b'\n')
s=Path('ACTUALBRIEF.md').read_text().replace('eight selected plans','nine selected plans')
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'ACTUALBRIEF.md'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
assert Path('bootstrap-receipt.json').is_file()
print('Exact20 gate keys and preserved object hashes/newline bytes consistent; nine plans, ten hops; bootstrap receipt present')
